full_page.content:
1947 August 24
The following is a faithful transcription of messages written on Seraphic Mass Association cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
Seraphic Mass Association - St. Felix Friary Huntington, Ind.
Prepared by patient suffering and by the Sacraments and prayers of our holy Mother the Church, on August 14th
- Mrs. Catherine O'Donnell - With joyful countenance received the final call of the divine Lover, Bridegroom of our souls and gently passed to Eternity.
Perpetually - with her whole family deceased and living August 24th, 1947 Fr. Solanus, OFM Cap
requested - by her son Joseph J. O'Donnell Praised be Jesus Christ!
Seraphic Mass Association -
Mr. and Mrs. Michael - Cath. - O'Donnell with whole Family - on both sides, deceased and living, parents, children with brothers and sisters of both - as one whole - ( enrolled) a perpetual membership. August 24, 1947 Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
requested by - Their son Joseph J. O'Donnell.
'God condescends to use our powers if we don't spoil His plans by ours. ' ( by) Monignor E'd F. Casey
